'''Donovia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CVD" /> located in the [[Donovia system/Legends|Donovia system]], a part of the [[Hali sector/Legends|Hali sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It featured rugged terrain and [[Water/Legends|rainy]] seasons.<ref name="CSWE Donovia" />

During the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] existence,<ref name="CSWE Donovia" /> the [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] known as [[Rainman/Legends|rainmen]], which included [[Human/Legends|Human]] members,<ref name="CVD" /> extensively [[Miner/Legends|mined]]<ref name="CSWE Donovia" /> many valuable materials on Donovia, in the process servicing signal towers there.<ref name="CVD" /> The rainmen wore distinctive rain [[Clothing/Legends|hoods]], which allowed them to effectively carry out<ref name="FF36">{{FactFile|36|FRE 1-4|Freighter Trampers}}</ref> close work<ref name="CVD" /> in extremely wet conditions.<ref name="FF36" /> By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> several Donovian rainmen had traveled offworld.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[20 BBY/Legends|Two years later]], Donovia remained undecided on its affiliation to either of the opposing factions of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|139|WOR 1-2|Worlds of the Clone Wars}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Donovia was first mentioned in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'' by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]].<ref name="AotCVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Donovia [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
